records.part: Grit removal equipment (multi-tray vortex tank system) for WRRF grit removal facility replacement
records.reason: Staff is requesting authorization to specify, with no equal, grit removal equipment to be provided by Hydro International, in an amount not-to-exceed $2,117,202.

records.part: Grit classifier component of the WRRF grit removal system
records.reason: coupled with the OpTeaCup classifier and Grit Snail dewatering system, would be the most effective system for removing grit, minimizing maintenance, and minimizing the space required for grit removal.

records.part: Grit dewatering system component of the WRRF grit removal system
records.reason: coupled with the OpTeaCup classifier and Grit Snail dewatering system, would be the most effective system for removing grit, minimizing maintenance, and minimizing the space required for grit removal.

records.part: Existing grit removal facility being replaced
records.reason: Grit removal at the WRRF is currently performed by the North Vacuator, which is nearing the end of its useful life, is inefficient, and technologically obsolete.
